name: The Rainbow Switch
author: ImMantaa
description: NOTE: The invisible spike on the floor has a 0.1% chance to be removed each attempt, making the secret way possible. LDM RECOMMENDED: Time a hold at the third column of platforms at 2% to go above the level. Time the pink orb at 4% and hold so you jump from both side of the platform at 5% and so you can click the later yellow orb at 5.8%. Jump from the left side of the platform at 6% and then jump out of the level from the right side of the lower platform (covered by the decoration) at 7%. Click once between 16.6-17.6% and 26.7%-27.2% to move invisible hitboxes. Stay at the floor to the end from there.
